knownBest.source: Packomania (compiled by Eckard Specht), m=5, n=1. No discoverer attributed in the source row. Coordinates imported from the public archive, normalized, decimalized and exactly verified by MinMax Arena. The web-table target and grid certificate are separate. Printed table value: 0.809016994375. Elementary optimality check: let P be the regular m-gon of circumradius one, with inradius a=cos(pi/m) and diameter D (2 for even m, 2cos(pi/(2m)) for odd m). Summing its unit-normal side inequalities gives r<=a, attained by the centred disc. For two discs r<a and the feasible centre region is exactly (1-r/a)P. Disjoint interiors require 2r<=D(1-r/a), hence r<=aD/(2a+D). Centres at a diameter pair of the scaled polygon attain equality. This solves the continuous problem. These irrational radii are unattainable on the nine-decimal radius grid; no grid-optimality claim is made.
